doc: A store: its listings filtered, sorted and searched as the agent says so, an item opened, and the cart filled once the visitor said yes. The page writes the performers (where the filters are, how the cart opens); the kit fixes what each move is and how it reports.

args.name: facet
args.doc: The filter as the listing names it: Tamaño, Color.

args.name: value
args.doc: One option as the listing writes it, or several joined by commas.

moves.say: {filter: Facet | Option} as you name a filter of the listing in front, one per sentence; {filter: Facet | Option, Option} for several options of one filter.
moves.doc: Apply one filter of the listing in front, one option or several of it, with the listing's own control.

moves.say: {sort: price_asc} as you say how the listing is ordered: price_asc, price_desc, relevance or newest.

args.name: query
args.doc: The words to type, in the store's language.

args.name: open_index
args.doc: Open the suggestion at this place, 0 for the first.

moves.doc: Type into the store's own search box at a human pace and let its suggestions open; open one when asked.

args.name: path
args.doc: The item's path on the store.

args.name: path
args.doc: The item's path; it is opened first when it is not in front.

moves.doc: Add an item to the cart, once the visitor said yes. Never the checkout.
Set how many of a cart line they have, or take it out, once the visitor said yes. Never the checkout.
Open the cart's drawer or page, or close it.

slices.doc: the listing in front: its title, how many it shows, the filters on and offered, the order, the first items
what is in their cart: each line, how many, the subtotal
